ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a line graph of the change in PM2.5 concentration in Beijing on a certain day, the horizontal axis represents time, the vertical axis represents PM2.5 concentration, and the curve shows that PM2.5 concentration has obvious fluctuations within one day, reflecting haze or air pollution conditions. Then reason: the key words in the question stem are “timely monitoring” and “affected area,” emphasizing the rapid acquisition of large-area spatial distribution information. Among geographic information technologies, remote sensing can monitor environmental conditions in real time or near real time over a relatively large area through satellites or aerial sensors, so it is used to timely monitor the affected area of haze weather.

raw_record.question_text: Which geographic information technology is mainly used to timely monitor the area affected by haze weather?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it is a line chart of PM2.5 concentration over one day, indicating a haze/air-pollution phenomenon. Then read the question phrase ‘及时监测……影响范围’, which emphasizes rapid monitoring of the spatial extent of haze. Use the rule that broad, real-time or near-real-time environmental monitoring over large areas is mainly done by 遥感. Conclude the technology is 遥感.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是北京市某日PM2.5浓度变化的折线图，横轴表示时间，纵轴表示PM2.5浓度，曲线显示一天内PM2.5浓度有明显波动，反映雾霾或空气污染状况。再推理：题干关键词是“及时监测”和“影响范围”，强调快速获取大范围空间分布信息。地理信息技术中，遥感可以通过卫星或航空传感器在较大区域内实时或近实时监测环境状况，因此用于及时监测雾霾天气的影响范围。

It uses the image only to identify the phenomenon as atmospheric PM2.5/haze, then applies the standard geographic-technology function mapping.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the line graph shows PM2.5 concentration changes, so the event to be monitored is haze pollution. Then focus on the wording ‘影响范围’ and compare technologies: positioning technology can locate points but cannot measure haze coverage; GIS can process and map data but usually needs data sources; remote sensing can repeatedly observe aerosol or haze distribution across a city or region. Select 遥感 as the main technology.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是北京市某日PM2.5浓度随时间变化的折线图，纵轴表示PM2.5浓度，横轴表示时刻，曲线显示一天内PM2.5浓度有明显波动并在傍晚前后达到较高值，说明所关注的事件是雾霾或颗粒物污染。再推理：题目问的是及时监测雾霾天气的影响范围，关键是范围监测。GPS等定位技术主要用于确定点的位置，不能直接获取雾霾覆盖范围；GIS主要用于对已有地理数据进行管理、分析和制图，需要外部数据来源；遥感可以通过卫星或航空传感器大范围、快速、连续地观测气溶胶和雾霾分布，适合及时监测城市或区域尺度的雾霾影响范围。因此主要使用的地理信息技术是遥感。

planner_metadata.image_role: Use the chart to confirm the context is monitoring an atmospheric pollution event, with PM2.5 concentration varying over time in Beijing.
